nodes.name: Google: Custom Product
nodes.description: Use to indicate whether or not the unique product identifiers (UPIs) GTIN, MPN, and brand are available for your product.

nodes.name: Product form
nodes.description: Defines the format or presentation of a product, typically for health and beauty; e.g. lotion, serum

nodes.name: Search product boosts
nodes.description: List of search queries for which a product gets higher rank in search results

nodes.name: Related products
nodes.description: List of related products

nodes.name: Related products settings
nodes.description: Determines how related products are displayed along with algorithmic product recommendations

nodes.name: Complementary products
nodes.description: List of complementary products

nodes.name: Age group
nodes.description: Defines the target age range for a product, such as adults or kids

nodes.name: Constitutive ingredients
nodes.description: Specifies the main components used in a product's formulation, e.g. beeswax, rosehip oil

nodes.name: Cosmetic function
nodes.description: Defines the intended benefit or effect of a cosmetic product, e.g. soothing, healing

nodes.name: Package type
nodes.description: Defines the type of packaging for a product, e.g. jar, pump

nodes.name: Product certifications & standards
nodes.description: Indicates the certifications or standards a product meets, such as organic or cruelty free

nodes.name: Suitable for skin type
nodes.description: Specifies products for specific skin conditions, such as dry, aging, or sensitive

nodes.name: Material
nodes.description: Defines a product's primary material, such as cotton or wool

nodes.name: Target gender
nodes.description: Identifies the intended gender for a product, such as female, male or unisex

nodes.name: Dispenser type
nodes.description: Specifies the format for dispensing the product, typically in health and beauty; e.g. stick, jar

nodes.name: Texture
nodes.description: Defines the feel or consistency of a product, such as creamy, matte, or absorbent

nodes.name: Skin care effect
nodes.description: Defines the intended benefits of skin care products, e.g. anti-aging, plumping

nodes.name: Fragrance level
nodes.description: Specifies the scent intensity of a product, e.g. unscented, lightly scented

nodes.name: Ingredient origin
nodes.description: Specifies the source of product ingredients, e.g. natural, synthetic

nodes.name: Skin care features
nodes.description: Identifies the benefits of skin care items, such as long lasting or UVA/UVB protection

nodes.name: Moisturizer type
nodes.description: Identifies the usage time of the moisturizer, like all day or night care

nodes.name: Active ingredient
nodes.description: Identifies primary substances in personal care items, e.g. vitamin A, retinol

nodes.name: Body area
nodes.description: Specifies the body part the product is designed for, e.g. face, bikini line

nodes.name: Cosmetic finish
nodes.description: Defines the cosmetic finish of a product, e.g. matte, natural
